en-US.title: beisammen
en-US.subtitle: Private photo circles
en-US.description:
beisammen is a private photo and video app for small circles such as partners, families, and close friends. Share into named circles, keep the wider internet out, and store original files on storage you control.

beisammen Cloud is an optional auto-renewable subscription (Plus or Max, monthly or yearly) that unlocks creating your own circles and cloud storage. Joining circles you are invited to is free. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase; the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://beisammen.app/en/privacy/
